# is referenced by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:isReferencedBy`](gmeow-isReferencedBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/isReferencedBy>
- **Category:** property

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when traversing or projecting from a resource to the things that point at it — back-references in a message thread or citation graph — reading the inverse direction of [`gmeow:references`](gmeow-references.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly when [`gmeow:references`](gmeow-references.md) already states the forward link (let it follow by inversion) and avoid using it for typed citations, where a [`gmeow:CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md) carries the intent and locus.

### How to use

- Prefer asserting [`gmeow:references`](gmeow-references.md) and read [`gmeow:isReferencedBy`](gmeow-isReferencedBy.md) as its inverse; state it explicitly only in target-rooted projections where the inverse direction is the natural one to write.
